title: Roulette betting
summary: Up to three players can now bet real chips on the roulette wheel, one spin a minute.
notes: Let up to three players take a seat at the roulette table: the first to sit opens a one-minute betting round, and seated players stay put until the spin ends or they cancel their bets and leave.

Add an overhead betting view with a chip rack from $1 to $25K: place any mix of chips on straight, split, street, corner, top-line, six-line, column, dozen and even-money bets, up to your wallet balance.
Spin the wheel when betting closes, sweep losing chips, mark the winning number and settle every player's bets at American roulette odds in one atomic wallet operation.
Add a dealer standing behind the roulette table.
